objective: Develop an applicability-aware ABCB1 efflux-risk screener for explicit free/released small-molecule structures with exactly three operational outputs: high_risk, low_risk, or abstain.
prediction_object: standardized free payload or explicitly defined released small-molecule structure
biological_scope: ABCB1-mediated efflux-risk triage in transporter assay space

v0_1_model.role: primary ordinary-drug structural prior and calibrated probability

three_output_semantics.high_risk: accepted high ABCB1 efflux-risk structural signal; not a definitive universal substrate call
three_output_semantics.low_risk: accepted low ABCB1 efflux-risk structural signal; not proof of absence of transport
three_output_semantics.abstain: insufficient, conflicting, unstable, identity-leaked, or out-of-scope evidence

frozen_decision_rule.threshold_source: v0.1 repeated exact-Murcko-grouped OOF predictions only

bootstrap_ensemble.interval: 10th to 90th percentile of calibrated ensemble probabilities
bootstrap_ensemble.acceptance_rule: the interval must remain on the same side of 0.5 as the primary call

physicochemical_envelope.score: maximum absolute robust z score using combined 443-row and 63-row reference medians and interquartile ranges
physicochemical_envelope.threshold: 99th percentile of the combined-reference score distribution

frozen_decision_rule.applicability_rule: abstain only when both frozen reference panels are below their already-frozen q10 nearest-neighbor support boundaries, or when the query is outside the frozen robust physicochemical envelope
frozen_decision_rule.model_disagreement_rule: when the direct-panel similarity is at or above its frozen q10 support boundary, v0.3 direction must agree with the primary direction
frozen_decision_rule.local_conflict_rule: a supported five-nearest-neighbor weighted vote strongly opposite to the primary direction triggers abstention
frozen_decision_rule.identity_rule: exact identity to either development panel is returned as abstain_reference_identity, not counted as a prospective model call
frozen_decision_rule.structure_rule: blank, unparsable, or failed-standardization structures abstain

evaluation_plan.primary_internal: selective coverage, accepted accuracy, high-risk precision, and low-risk negative predictive value on frozen grouped OOF probabilities
historical_posthoc_diagnostics: regulatory strict pool v4: already scored before this lock; diagnostic only
ASAP 2025 source-heldout set: outcome already observed before this lock; diagnostic only
evaluation_plan.future_confirmation_required: a newly locked, outcome-unseen matched-parental or inhibitor-rescue source with both positive and negative calls
evaluation_plan.ranking_context: ASAP 2025 supports continuous direction but cannot validate a matched-parental binary substrate call

prohibitions: do not tune thresholds or rejector rules on ASAP 2025 or regulatory v4 outcomes
do not call historical posthoc diagnostics external validation of v0.4
do not convert abstain into a biological third class
do not use whole-ADC structures as if they were released payload structures
do not hide coverage or class-specific accepted counts

go_no_go.operational_build_gate: all dependency hashes match, all three outputs are reachable in smoke tests, deterministic batch scoring passes, and every abstention has machine-readable reasons
go_no_go.claim_gate: remain a development research triage tool until future outcome-unseen source-grouped confirmation is passed
